item.title: Call for Applications: Fellowship for Journalistic Excellence 2026
item.description: Photo: BIRN/Igor Vujcic We are offering 8 to 10 fellowships to journalists from Central and South Eastern Europe with compelling story ideas that require on-the-ground reporting, in-depth research, dedicated editorial support, and funding. The post Call for Applications: Fellowship for Journalistic Excellence 2026 appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: Ada Petriczko
item.description: Ada Petriczko joined BIRN Hub as Poland Correspondent in December 2025. She is based in Warsaw and reports on politics, human rights, social justice and regional affairs, with a focus on investigative and long-form journalism. The post Ada Petriczko appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: Open Call for Investigative Journalism and Research on Media Freedom and Journalists’ Safety in Albania
item.description: Photo: BIRN Albania The Balkan Investigative Reporting Network Albania (BIRN Albania), in partnership with the Science for Innovation Development Centre (SCiDEV) and Qendra Faktoje, announces a new round of grants for journalists and researchers to produce evidence-based investigations, analytical reports, and in-depth research addressing media freedom and journalists’ safety in Albania. item.title: BIRN Macedonia’s Contribution to Professional Investigations Recognised
item.description: Photo: Tomislav Georgiev On February 17 in Skopje, at an event marking the 80th anniversary of the Association of Journalists of Macedonia, the Association recognised BIRN Macedonia for its contribution to professional investigative journalism. The post BIRN Macedonia’s Contribution to Professional Investigations Recognised appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: BIRN Kosovo and Internews Kosova Launch the Documentary “Smuggling Without Borders”
item.description: Photo: BIRN Kosovo On February 20 in Pristina, BIRN Kosovo and Internews Kosova have launched the documentary “Smuggling without borders” which examines illegal networks involved in migrant smuggling through irregular routes in Kosovo, including the misuse of work visa applications. The post BIRN Kosovo and Internews Kosova Launch the Documentary “Smuggling Without Borders” appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: BIRN Montenegro Holds Workshop on Crypto Risks and Illicit Financial Flows
item.description: Photo: BIRN Montenegro On February 20, BIRN Montenegro concluded a three-day workshop, “Identification and Assessment of Risks in the Field of Crypto Assets and Illicit Financial Flows Through Sophisticated Digital Forms”, for journalists and state institutions representatives. The post BIRN Montenegro Holds Workshop on Crypto Risks and Illicit Financial Flows appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: BIRN Albania Publishes a New Report on Election-Related FIMI
item.description: Photo: Pexels / Edmond Dantès BIRN Albania has published a new analytical report analysing how Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference (FIMI) intersected with the dynamics of Albania’s 2025 parliamentary elections. The post BIRN Albania Publishes a New Report on Election-Related FIMI appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: BIRN Kosovo Marks Anniversary of Ukraine Invasion with Fifth Doc on Russian Disinformation
item.description: Photo: BIRN Kosovo On 24 February, marking the fourth anniversary of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, BIRN Kosovo and Internews Kosovo premiered the fifth and final documentary in their investigative series about disinformation and foreign malign influence. The post BIRN Kosovo Marks Anniversary of Ukraine Invasion with Fifth Doc on Russian Disinformation appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: Meet the People Behind BIRN: Maida Selmanovic
item.description: Photo: Private archive Maida Selmanovic is the Financial Director in BIRN Hub’s office in Sarajevo. She studied at the University of Economic Tourism and has been working with BIRN since 2008. The post Meet the People Behind BIRN: Maida Selmanovic appeared first on BIRN.
